gcal.syncErrors: {count} bookings waiting to sync; they will be retried automatically.
gcal.notConfigured: The Google Calendar integration is not enabled on the platform yet.
gcal.noPermission: Only an admin or the {staff} themselves can connect this calendar.

my.notLinked: Your user is not linked to any {staff}. Ask an admin to link you in {staffPlural} to connect your calendar.

admin.title: Google Calendar
admin.subtitle: Google Cloud OAuth client used by every workspace to connect their agents' calendars.
admin.redirectHelp: Paste it in Google Cloud → APIs & Services → Credentials → your OAuth client (Web application).
admin.webhookHelp: Google sends calendar changes here. Requires HTTPS; without HTTPS the cron polls every ~5 minutes.
admin.pushOff: The site is not on HTTPS: push notifications are off and polling is used.
admin.removeConfirm: Remove the Google credentials from the panel? Environment variables will be used if present.
admin.setupTitle: What to set up in Google Cloud
admin.setup1: Enable the Google Calendar API in your project.
admin.setup2: OAuth consent screen: External user type, app name and logo, authorized domain and support email.
admin.setup3: Scopes: openid, email, calendar.events and calendar.freebusy.
admin.setup4: Create an OAuth client ID of type “Web application” with the redirect URI above.
admin.setup5: While the app is unverified, add your agents as test users (their access expires every 7 days). calendar.events is a sensitive scope: publish the app and request Google verification.
